svg.text: THE OVERLAPS, RE-TESTED AGAINST RECOVERED DATA
Egyptian-registered jets and the Kirks, January 2022 – October 2025. Each bar is one month.
The tracking-site records were scrubbed, so every claim was re-checked against raw ADS-B traces we pulled and kept.
dated claimed overlaps
tallies broadcast as “73”

corroborated — a trace we hold puts the jet at the claimed field
right area, wrong field — within 50 miles, not at the airport named
refuted — a trace we hold puts the jet somewhere else
not testable — no archive reaches back, or no aircraft was named
WHAT THE RECOVERED TRACES SHOW AT PROVO
4 SEP 2025 — SU-BTT lands Provo, 12:45 pm — inbound from 8,100 km out
5–10 SEP — SU-BND transmits from the ground at Provo every day
10 SEP 2025 — SU-BTT departs Provo, 07:14 am
10 SEP 2025 — SU-BND still on the ground at 2:29 pm — it never leaves
Charlie Kirk is killed at UVU, Orem — 7 miles away — at 12:23 pm
Times are Mountain, read off the trace. A trace proves presence — never who was aboard.

Claim counts are researcher tallies attributed to Candace Owens and others. Every fill is computed from raw ADS-B trace files recovered from adsb.lol and airplanes.live and kept in this repo, measured point-by-point: corroborated = within 15 km of the claimed field that day.

Dotted bars are days no free archive reaches — a retention limit, tested against unrelated control aircraft, not evidence of anything. Erika Kirk’s itinerary has never been published, so no trace can place her aboard. Nothing here is a finding of wrongdoing by any living person.
